Need surveillance at a farmhouse, warehouse, or remote property where Wi-Fi, broadband, or wiring is difficult to arrange? The CP PLUS EZ-S35T 3MP 4G PT Camera uses a 4G SIM to enable remote monitoring on your smartphone, as long as mobile network coverage is available.
Paired with the CP-SL06K Solar Panel Kit, the setup supports solar charging and battery backup for locations where a conventional power setup may be difficult. Security features include Human Detection, Motion Tracking, Full-Colour Night Vision, two-way audio, a built-in siren, and remote pan-and-tilt control.
